description: Scan a directory for hardcoded credentials before packing it with repomix, refuse to pack if anything is found, cite each finding's exact file and line, and pack with repomix automatically once the scan is clean — scan and pack as one step, never "scan now, run repomix yourself after." Use whenever the user wants to run repomix, pack or bundle a codebase into a single file, make a reference copy for a contractor or reviewer, or prep a project as LLM context — even if they only say "repomix this" or "pack this directory" without mentioning security. Also use as a standalone scanner when the user just wants to check a directory for leaked API keys, passwords, tokens, or DB credentials without packing anything. Distinguishes a CONFIRMED leak from a PATTERN MATCH that merely looks secret-shaped (may be a placeholder like "your_api_key_here") — never conflate the two.
